### Why Speed Is the Most Underrated Factor in Background Verification


Most background verification tools in India take 24 hours to 10 days to deliver results. During that gap, three things happen that cost your business money:


**1. You lose candidates.** In India’s competitive tech and services hiring market, a top candidate who accepts your offer on Monday may receive a better offer by Wednesday. If your BGV takes 5 business days, you are onboarding unverified or losing the candidate entirely.


**2. You onboard unverified employees.** When hiring timelines are tight, HR teams skip verification or start employees before results arrive. AuthBridge’s H1 FY26 report found a **4.33% discrepancy rate** across white-collar hires. That means for every 100 employees you onboard without waiting for verification, 4 statistically have fraudulent credentials — and they already have system access.


**3. You waste HR time on follow-ups.** A verification that takes 72 hours generates 2-3 follow-up emails between HR, the BGV vendor, and the candidate. At 20 hires per month, that is 40-60 unnecessary email threads.


The solution is not to skip verification. It is to use tools that deliver results in seconds, not days.


This blog reviews the 5 fastest background check tools that give results in under 5 minutes — ranked by actual end-to-end time from starting a check to seeing the result.


**What you will find in this blog:**


- A comparison table ranking all 5 tools by speed
- Detailed review of each tool’s turnaround time by check type
- A speed breakdown showing exactly how long each check takes on each platform
- Why most BGV tools take days (and which delays are unnecessary)
- A decision framework based on your urgency level
- 10 FAQs answered

### 1. SalaryBox Verify — Fastest All-in-One Background Check (Results in Seconds)


**Website:**[salarybox.in/verify](https://salarybox.in/verify/)


**Pricing:** Rs. 499 per candidate (flat rate, all checks included)


**Speed:** Results in seconds. End-to-end time from account creation to PDF report download: under 2 minutes.


**Checks Covered:** PAN (Income Tax Department), Voter ID (Election Commission), Driving Licence (Parivahan/Sarathi), UAN/EPFO past employment history


**Why SalaryBox Verify Is the Fastest Background Check Tool:**


SalaryBox Verify is the only tool on this list where a non-technical HR person can go from zero (no account, no setup) to a complete, downloadable verification report in under 2 minutes. Here is the speed breakdown:


- **Account creation:** 1 minute. Enter your email, set a password, and you are in. No sales call, no approval process, no waiting for account activation.
- **Candidate entry and check selection:** 30 seconds. Enter the candidate’s name and ID numbers (PAN, Voter ID, DL, UAN). Select which checks to run.
- **Payment confirmation:** 15 seconds. Review the Rs. 499 price and confirm through secure checkout.
- **Results:** Instant. Government database responses arrive in seconds. PAN matches the Income Tax Department record. Voter ID confirms the Election Commission record. DL checks against Parivahan. EPFO pulls the complete employment history.
- **PDF report download:** 10 seconds. Click download. The report includes verification results with masked sensitive data, ready for your HR file.


**Total: Under 2 minutes from first visit to completed report.**


**What makes this speed possible:**


- **Direct government database queries:** SalaryBox Verify queries the Income Tax Department, Election Commission, Parivahan/Sarathi, and EPFO databases in real time. These are electronic queries that return in seconds — the same way a bank verifies your PAN during account opening.
- **No manual verification layer:** Unlike tools such as AuthBridge, SpringVerify, and HireRight that add manual steps (reference calls, field visits, university outreach), SalaryBox Verify relies entirely on government database responses. There is no human in the loop to slow things down.
- **No queuing system:** Some platforms queue your request behind other clients’ requests. SalaryBox Verify processes each check individually as it is submitted — no batching delays.
- **Automatic cross-referencing:** The platform compares names and dates of birth across databases in real time. Manual cross-referencing (comparing PAN results with Voter ID results yourself) would add 5-10 minutes. SalaryBox Verify does it in the same seconds.


**Speed in context:**


SalaryBox Verify is not fast because it cuts corners. It is fast because government database queries are inherently instant — the Income Tax Department API responds in milliseconds. The platforms that take 24-72 hours are slow because they add manual verification steps on top of the same database queries. For identity and employment verification through government records, there is no technical reason for results to take more than seconds.


**Best for:** Any HR team, hiring manager, or business owner who needs verified identity and employment results during the same conversation where they decide to verify — not hours or days later.

### 2. SurePass — Instant Government Database APIs (1-5 Seconds Per Check, Developer Only)


**Website:**[surepass.io](https://surepass.io/)


**Pricing:** Rs. 1-5 per API call (volume-based tiers; free sandbox)


**Speed:** 1-5 seconds per API response. But 2-4 weeks setup time before first check (developer integration required).


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, DL, UAN/EPFO, Aadhaar (OKYC), Passport, GST, RC, MCA, bank account, 100+ government databases


**Strengths:**


- **Fastest raw API response:** SurePass’s government database APIs return results in 1-5 seconds per call — the fastest individual query speed on this list.
- **100+ database coverage:** Widest government database access. If a database exists in digital form, SurePass likely has an API for it.
- **Pay-per-call pricing:** At Rs. 1-5 per API call, running 4 checks per candidate costs Rs. 4-20 in direct API fees.
- **Free sandbox for testing:** Validate your integration with dummy data before going live.


**Limitations:**


- **2-4 weeks before your first real check:** SurePass is fast after integration, not fast to start. A developer must write code, build an interface, handle errors, and test before HR can run a single check. This setup time means your “5-second check” actually takes 2-4 weeks plus 5 seconds.
- **Developer required:** No web interface for HR teams. Every check requires code that a developer wrote and deployed.
- **No PDF reports:** Returns raw JSON data. Your team must build a reporting layer.
- **Hidden total cost:** Rs. 1-5 per API call sounds fast and cheap, but add Rs. 20,000-1,50,000+ in developer time, and the per-candidate cost for small businesses far exceeds SalaryBox Verify’s Rs. 499.


**Best for:** Tech companies with developer teams that want to build sub-second verification into their own products.


**Verdict:** SurePass has the fastest raw API speed. But “fast” for HR teams means fast from decision-to-verify to results-in-hand — not fast after weeks of development. SalaryBox Verify delivers the same core checks (PAN, Voter ID, DL, EPFO) in seconds with zero setup time.


### 3. Cashfree Employee Verification — Quick Digital ID Checks for Fintech-Adjacent Companies


**Pricing:** Per-check pricing (varies by check type and volume; contact sales for rates)


**Speed:** PAN and bank account checks: seconds. DL checks: seconds to minutes. Employment verification: varies. Overall: 2-5 minutes for supported digital checks.


**Checks Covered:** PAN verification, bank account verification, Driving Licence, Aadhaar (OKYC), basic employment history


**Strengths:**


- **Fast PAN and bank verification:** Cashfree’s core strength is financial verification — PAN and bank account checks return in seconds. If your primary need is confirming a candidate’s PAN matches their bank account name, Cashfree is fast and reliable.
- **Fintech-grade infrastructure:** Built on Cashfree’s payment processing backbone, the verification APIs benefit from enterprise-grade uptime and speed.
- **Familiar for Cashfree users:** Companies already using Cashfree for payments can add employee verification through the same platform and billing relationship.


**Limitations:**


- **Limited ID coverage:** Cashfree’s strength is financial IDs (PAN, bank account), not broad identity verification. Voter ID coverage is limited or absent. UAN/EPFO depth is narrower than SalaryBox Verify’s direct EPFO employment history check.
- **Integration required:** Cashfree’s verification is primarily API-based. HR teams without developer support cannot use it as a standalone tool.
- **Not designed for HR workflows:** Cashfree built employee verification as an extension of its fintech platform, not as an HR tool. No candidate management, no PDF reports designed for HR files, no verification workspace.
- **Pricing not transparent:** Rates are not publicly listed for all check types. Sales engagement may be required for pricing.


**Best for:** Fintech companies and businesses already using Cashfree for payments that want to add fast PAN and bank account verification for new hires through the same platform.


**Verdict:** Cashfree is fast for PAN and bank checks but limited in HR-relevant ID coverage. SalaryBox Verify covers PAN + Voter ID + DL + UAN/EPFO in a single HR-friendly workflow at Rs. 499 — broader checks, faster end-to-end, and no developer requirement.


### 4. OnGrid Instant Verification — Fast Identity Checks With Court Record Add-On


**Pricing:** Rs. 250-500 per individual check (varies by check type)


**Speed:** Identity checks (PAN, DL): minutes. EPFO: minutes to hours. Criminal/education: 24-48 hours.


**Checks Covered:** PAN, DL, UAN/EPFO employment history, criminal records (court checks), education, address verification


**Strengths:**


- **Fast identity checks with slow add-ons available:** OnGrid’s “Instant Verification” delivers identity checks in minutes while still offering criminal and education checks (24-48 hours) through the same platform. This two-speed approach lets you get fast identity confirmation while slower checks run in the background.
- **Strong EPFO expertise:** OnGrid’s UAN/EPFO verification is well-regarded. Their FY 2024-25 data documented 3.6 lakh BGV failures.
- **Per-check flexibility:** Pay only for the checks you need. Run a quick PAN-only check for Rs. 250 or a full identity + criminal package.
- **Veriffy app for quick checks:** Their consumer-facing app allows fast identity verification from a mobile device.


**Limitations:**


- **“Instant” is minutes, not seconds:** OnGrid’s identity checks typically return in minutes, not the seconds that SalaryBox Verify delivers. For checks that need to happen during a live conversation, minutes can feel slow.
- **Criminal and education checks are not fast:** At 24-48 hours, these add-on checks do not qualify as “under 5 minutes.” Only the identity checks are fast.
- **Per-check costs add up:** Running PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO individually costs Rs. 1,000-2,000. SalaryBox Verify bundles all four for Rs. 499.
- **Limited Voter ID coverage:** Voter ID verification may not be available or may have limited depth.


**Best for:** Companies that need fast identity checks initially (minutes) with the option to add criminal and education checks (24-48 hours) through the same platform.


**Verdict:** OnGrid delivers reasonably fast identity checks with the flexibility to add slower comprehensive checks when needed. For the fastest possible government database verification (seconds, not minutes), SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 is the faster and cheaper option.


### 5. DIY Government Portal Checks — 5-30 Minutes Per Portal, Free But Manual


**Speed:** 5-30 minutes per portal. Total for all 4 checks: 20-120 minutes (depending on portal load, CAPTCHAs, and downtime).


**Checks Covered:** PAN status, Voter ID lookup, DL validity, UAN/EPFO membership (limited)


**Strengths:**


- **Zero cost:** The only free option on this list.
- **Can technically complete in under 5 minutes per portal:** On a good day, with working CAPTCHAs and no portal downtime, an individual PAN or DL check can be done in 5 minutes.


**Limitations:**


- **Total time is 20-120 minutes, not under 5:** Running all four checks across four separate government portals takes 20 minutes at best, over 2 hours at worst. This does not qualify as “under 5 minutes” for a complete verification.
- **Portal downtime is unpredictable:** Government websites frequently experience outages. A check that takes 5 minutes when working can take 30+ minutes with retries and CAPTCHA failures.
- **No cross-referencing:** You must manually compare names across PAN, Voter ID, and DL results. SalaryBox Verify does this automatically in seconds.
- **No PDF reports or audit trail:** No downloadable report. Manual documentation required.
- **Limited EPFO access:** Full employment history requires the employee’s UAN and linked mobile number.


**Best for:** Micro-businesses (1-3 employees) with zero budget and willingness to spend 20-120 minutes per candidate.


**Verdict:** DIY portals are free but not fast. The “under 5 minutes” promise applies only to a single check on a good day — not to a complete verification. SalaryBox Verify runs all four checks in seconds for Rs. 499, saving 20-120 minutes of manual work and delivering automated cross-referencing and PDF reports.

## Why Most BGV Tools Take Days, Not Minutes


If government database queries return in seconds, why do most background verification companies take 24 hours to 10 days? The answer lies in what they add on top of the database query:


Delay Source Time Added Why It Exists Is It Necessary?


**Queuing/batching** 2-24 hours Platform processes requests in batches rather than individually No — SalaryBox Verify processes each check individually in real time


**Manual data entry by vendor** 1-4 hours A vendor employee re-enters your candidate’s details into their internal system No — self-serve tools eliminate this step entirely


**Reference calls to previous employers** 1-5 days Calling the candidate’s previous employer’s HR department and waiting for a callback Partially — EPFO checks provide tamper-proof employment data without reference calls


**Court record searches** 2-7 days Manual or semi-automated searches across 600+ district courts Yes — court records require physical or digital court-by-court searches


**Education verification** 3-7 days Contacting universities for degree confirmation Yes — universities respond at their own pace


**Field address verification** 2-5 days Sending a field agent to physically visit the candidate’s address Yes for physical verification; not needed for digital address confirmation


**Report preparation** 1-24 hours A vendor analyst reviews results and prepares a formatted report No — automated platforms generate reports instantly


**Quality review** 2-8 hours A senior analyst reviews the report before releasing it to the client No for automated database checks (the government database response is the final answer)


**The key insight:** Of the 8 delay sources, only 3 are genuinely necessary (court records, education verification, field visits). The other 5 are operational inefficiencies that add hours or days to what should be a seconds-long process.


SalaryBox Verify eliminates all 5 unnecessary delays:


- No queuing (each check processed individually)
- No manual data entry (self-serve input by the HR user)
- No reference calls (direct EPFO database query instead)
- No report preparation delay (automated PDF generation)
- No quality review layer (government database response is definitive)


**The result:** What takes other platforms 24 hours to 10 days takes SalaryBox Verify seconds.

### FAQs: Fast Background Check Tools in India


###### 1. What is the fastest background check tool in India?


SalaryBox Verify is the fastest end-to-end background check tool for HR teams. It delivers PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, and UAN/EPFO verification results in seconds, with a complete PDF report downloadable in under 2 minutes from account creation. SurePass has faster raw API responses (1-5 seconds) but requires weeks of developer integration before the first check.


###### 2. Can a background check really be completed in under 5 minutes?


Yes, for government database checks. PAN, Voter ID, DL, and UAN/EPFO verification queries electronic government databases that respond in seconds. SalaryBox Verify completes all four checks and generates a PDF report in under 2 minutes. Criminal record checks (court searches) and education verification (university outreach) cannot be completed in under 5 minutes because they involve manual or semi-manual processes.


###### 3. Are instant background checks less accurate than slower ones?


No. SalaryBox Verify queries the exact same government databases (Income Tax Department, Election Commission, Parivahan, EPFO) that slower tools query. The data source is identical. Slower tools add manual steps (reference calls, field visits, report review) on top of the same database queries. For identity and employment verification, the government database response is the most accurate data available — manual layers do not improve it.


###### 4. Why do AuthBridge and SpringVerify take days if the database query is instant?


Because they add manual verification layers: queuing your request, re-entering data, calling previous employers, preparing narrative reports, and running quality reviews. These steps add value for criminal and education checks (which require manual outreach) but add unnecessary delay for identity checks (which are purely database queries). SalaryBox Verify eliminates these manual layers for identity and employment checks.


###### 5. Can I run a background check during a phone interview with SalaryBox Verify?


Yes. If you have the candidate’s PAN number and UAN (or other ID numbers), you can open SalaryBox Verify in a browser tab during the call, enter the details, pay Rs. 499, and have results before the conversation ends. This allows you to make a verified hiring decision on the same call.


###### 6. Does SalaryBox Verify’s instant check catch moonlighting?


Yes. The UAN/EPFO check pulls the candidate’s complete PF contribution history from EPFO government records. If another employer is making active PF contributions for the same candidate, it indicates concurrent employment (moonlighting). EY India found 45% of IT employees moonlighted — and EPFO records are the fastest way to detect it.


###### 7. What checks cannot be completed in under 5 minutes?


Criminal record checks (court searches across 600+ district courts: 24 hours to 7 days), education verification (university outreach: 24 hours to 7 days), physical address verification (field agent visits: 2-5 days), and international checks (cross-border verification: 3-10 days). These checks involve manual processes that cannot be automated to seconds.


###### 8. Is Rs. 499 for instant results more expensive than slower alternatives?


No. SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 is cheaper than every other paid tool on this list except SurePass’s per-API-call pricing (which requires Rs. 20,000-1,50,000+ in developer integration costs). SpringVerify costs Rs. 799-1,599, AuthBridge costs Rs. 1,500-3,000+, and HireRight costs Rs. 2,000-5,000+. SalaryBox Verify is both the fastest and most affordable for identity and employment checks.


###### 9. Should I skip slow background checks entirely and use only instant tools?


No. Use the layered approach: instant checks (SalaryBox Verify) for every hire to cover identity and employment verification, plus slow checks (SpringVerify or AuthBridge) for the 10-20% of roles that need criminal records, education verification, or address checks. Never skip verification entirely because your preferred tool is slow — use an instant tool for the basics while slower checks run in parallel.


###### 10. How fast will background checks be in the future?


Identity checks (PAN, Voter ID, DL) are already instant and will stay instant. EPFO employment checks are instant and improving in depth. Criminal record checks are getting faster as courts digitise records (some high courts now respond in hours rather than days). Education verification is being automated through digital degree verification initiatives. By 2027-2028, most check types that currently take days should be completable in hours or less.
